name: What information do you need to start an AI SEO audit?
description: To start an AI SEO audit, we need access to Google Analytics, Search Console, your business goals, and optionally, your CMS.

mainEntity.name: What information do you need to start an AI SEO audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: To initiate an AI SEO audit, we typically require access to your Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and any other relevant analytics platforms you use. We also need a clear understanding of your business goals, target audience, and current marketing strategies. Providing access to your website's CMS (Content Management System) can also be beneficial for a more in-depth technical analysis and implementation planning.
